storage.actions.create-variant.helpConte:
Create a copy compatible with save.
It allows to use pokémon which may be not-compatible with any generation.
All variants shares same exp, level, EVs, but each one handles its own moves.
storage.actions.detach-main.helpContent:
Break link between this pokémon and the one in save (if exists).
Allows to use pokémon in another save, and create new variants.
storage.actions.detach-main.helpTitle: Detach pokémon from attached one in save
storage.actions.detach-save.helpContent:
Break link between this pokémon and the one in storage.
Allows to use pokémon in another save, and create new variants.
storage.actions.detach-save.helpTitle: Detach pokémon from attached one in storage
storage.actions.move-attached-main.helpC:
Move a copy to save, attached to stored pokémon.
An attached pokémon synchronizes its data from save with source stored pokémon: exp, level, EVs, moves, nickname.
This allows to use the same pokémon later in another save even if it's not the same generation
storage.actions.move-attached-main.helpT: Move a linked copy of this pokémon to the save
storage.actions.move-attached-save.helpC:
Move a copy to storage, attached to save pokémon.
An attached pokémon synchronizes its data from save with source stored pokémon: exp, level, EVs, moves, nickname.
This allows to use the same pokémon later in another save even if it's not the same generation
